title: 1. Top shell & buttons
fact: The shell is the outside of the controller. It protects the parts inside and holds the buttons.
source: iFixit, DualSense Controller repair and teardown guides

title: 2. Thumbstick caps
fact: The caps are the parts your thumbs touch. They sit on top of the sticks and make the sticks easy to move.
source: iFixit, DualSense Controller repair and teardown guides

title: 3. Inner frame
fact: The frame holds all the parts in place. It makes the controller strong and keeps the front and the back together.
source: iFixit, DualSense Controller repair and teardown guides

title: 4. Main board (PCB)
fact: The circuit board is the brain of the controller. It reads your buttons and sticks and sends the signal to the game.
source: iFixit, DualSense Controller repair and teardown guides

title: 5. Stick modules
fact: A stick module measures where you push the stick. It tells the game which way to move. This part wears out easily, and then stick drift can happen.
source: iFixit, DualSense Controller repair and teardown guides

title: 6. Battery & motors
fact: The battery gives power to the controller. The motors make it shake when something happens in the game.
source: iFixit, DualSense Controller repair and teardown guides
